name: Introduction to Python Functions
description: Students are asked to write Python functions demonstrating their understanding of basic function design, parameters, and return values.

problems.name: Problem 1 — Factorial
problems.description: Write a Python function factorial(n) that returns the factorial of a non-negative integer n. Your solution must handle the base case and use recursion.

criteria.description: Correct base case (n == 0 or n == 1 returns 1)
Student demonstrates clear understanding of why recursion terminates (explanation or comment required)

problems.name: Problem 2 — Palindrome
problems.description: Write a Python function is_palindrome(s) that returns True if the string s is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), False otherwise. It must be case-insensitive.

criteria.description: Solution is reasonably efficient and avoids obviously redundant operations
